optimizedDescription.value: Compiles change-independent project spec context across all workspaces, preferring fresh optimized context and optional dependsOn traversal.

optimizedContext.value:
# GetProjectContext

## Rules
- `execute(input: GetProjectContextInput)` optional: `contextMode` (`'list' | 'summary' | 'full' | 'hybrid'`), `llmOptimizedContext`, `followDeps`, `depth`, `sections: ReadonlyArray<SpecSection>` (`"rules"`, `"constraints"`, `"scenarios"`). Absent `contextMode` / `llmOptimizedContext` use construction baked defaults. MUST NOT include `config`.
- Start of `execute`: shallow-merge `defaultConfig` with runtime overrides (`contextMode`, `llmOptimizedContext`) into effective `CompileContextConfig`. Hosts MUST NOT pass yaml-derived configuration on each call.
- Return `Promise<GetProjectContextResult>`: ordered `contextEntries`, deduped `specs: ContextSpecEntry[]` (`specId`, `source`, `mode`, optional `title`, `description`, `content`), `warnings: ContextWarning[]`. All specs `source: 'includePattern'`. `hybrid` equals `full`. `full` MUST be structured metadata/extraction, never raw markdown.
- Resolve schema first via `SchemaProvider.get()`; propagate `SchemaNotFoundError` and `SchemaValidationError`.
- Render `config.context` before specs, declaration order. `instruction`: label `**Source: instruction**`. `file`: read via `FileReader`, label `**Source: <path>**`, headings +1. Missing file: emit `missing-file`, skip entry.
- Collect via `config.contextIncludeSpecs` across all workspaces, then remove `config.contextExcludeSpecs`. Matching MUST use `resolveConfiguredContextSpecs` (`core:resolve-context-specs`) with empty `activeWorkspaces` so only project-level steps run. MUST NOT reimplement a separate project-only `listMatchingSpecs` include/exclude loop. Collected-set semantics MUST stay equivalent to previous project-only `listMatchingSpecs`: same project glob qualification as `CompileContext`; configured workspaces available for project-pattern matching.
- MUST NOT apply workspace-level `contextIncludeSpecs` or `contextExcludeSpecs`. Enforce with empty `activeWorkspaces` (helper steps 3–4 skipped), not a forked matcher.
- `followDeps: true`: traverse transitive `dependsOn` from `.specd-metadata.yaml`. Order: (1) canonical `dependsOn` from `GetSpecMetadata.execute({ specId })` default `'if-needed'` (self-healing; missing/drifted cache regenerated); (2) schema `metadataExtraction.dependsOn` fallback only when materialization cannot produce a projection. Fallback MUST use shared extractor-transform registry and caller-owned origin context bag. Add discovered specs. Respect `depth` (`1` = direct; absent = unlimited). Transform normalization failure MUST fail explicitly. MUST NOT read `spec-lock.json` to discover deps; sidecars only through `GetSpecMetadata` normalized projection.
- Display mode from effective `config.contextMode`. Call `GetSpecMetadata.execute({ specId })` only when mode needs structured metadata (summary fields or full section content). `list`: no title/description/content, MUST NOT call `GetSpecMetadata`. `summary`: title + description. `full`/`hybrid`: description, rules, constraints, scenarios as applicable. Absent/empty `sections` defaults to Description + Rules + Constraints; explicit `sections` overrides. Filters do not affect list/summary.
- MUST NOT warn solely because a projection was regenerated (`source`, `regenerated` are provenance). Forward actionable materialization failures such as `metadata-cache-write-failed` into `warnings` without logging again.
- `llmOptimizedContext` enabled and rendered spec projection lacks usable `optimizedContext`: emit `missing-optimization` (never optimized) or `stale-optimization` (baselines drifted). Remediation MUST say `Launch specd-spec-context-optimizer agent to refresh`. No change-scope exemptions.
- When `GetSpecMetadata` cannot produce a valid in-memory projection: emit `missing-metadata`; live-extract via schema `metadataExtraction`, shared extractor-transform registry, caller-owned origin context; same section filtering; no declarations → empty spec heading. Found-but-unnormalizable transformed values MUST fail explicitly.
- Constructor: `listWorkspaces: ListWorkspaces`, `schemaProvider: SchemaProvider`, `files: FileReader`, `getMetadata: GetSpecMetadata`, `parsers: ArtifactParserRegistry`, `defaultConfig: CompileContextConfig`. Schema resolves lazily on first access.
- `llmOptimizedContext` enabled: prefer cached optimized project context from `core:project-metadata` when fresh. Freshness from semantic metadata fingerprints — `specd.yaml`, referenced `contextFiles`, materialized metadata fingerprint of every included spec — not raw cache-file hashes or repository revisions. Disabled: MUST NOT return cached optimized project context as primary response even if fresh; continue standard compilation. If cache fresh and `optimized.context` exists and is not empty, use it only when optimization enabled. Otherwise emit warning containing `Launch specd-project-context-optimizer agent to generate it` and fall back to standard compilation.
- Config factory `createGetProjectContext(config, options?)` MUST derive deps through `resolveGetProjectContextDeps(resolver)`, then delegate to canonical `createGetProjectContext(deps)`. Resolver supplies `listWorkspaces: ListWorkspaces`, `schemaProvider: SchemaProvider`, `files: FileReader`, `getMetadata: GetSpecMetadata`, `parsers: ArtifactParserRegistry`, `hasher: ContentHasher`, `extractorTransforms: ExtractorTransformRegistry`, `workspaceRoutes: readonly SpecWorkspaceRoute[]`, `defaultConfig: CompileContextConfig`. Helper is only use-case-specific composition entry for config-based bootstrap. Factory MUST NOT reconstruct fs-shaped wiring inline.

## Constraints
- No change context; all workspaces active.
- Project patterns only; workspace patterns forbidden.
- Duplicate include matches collapse to one spec.
- Context entries precede spec content.
- Async: `Promise<GetProjectContextResult>`.
- Formatting matches `CompileContext`.
- `dependsOn` traversal only when `followDeps: true`.
